answer: A harness is the code that manages an LLM, allowing it to behave in a specific way [1], [2]. It manages the model by applying context, running tools, and controlling how the model does things [1], [2]. The harness is described as the “engine” of the LLM, similar to how a harness is needed to drive a car [1], [2]. It utilizes files from a folder to provide context and can access tools such as search, code execution, and calculation [1], [3]. It also maintains a memory of past conversations and actions within a project [3].
